risks.risk_name: Unmasked Aadhaar Display to All Staff
risks.description: Full 12-digit Aadhaar numbers of both primary applicants and co-applicants are visible to all 45 Customer Care staff in Salesforce without masking. This violates Aadhaar Act provisions that restrict storage and display of full Aadhaar numbers.
risks.evidence: Aadhaar Number [UNMASKED — full 12 digits visible] ... Co-Applicant Aadhaar [UNMASKED] ... Full Aadhaar numbers of both primary applicant AND co-applicant are visible to ALL 45 Customer Care staff. Under Aadhaar Act provisions, storage and display of full Aadhaar is restricted.
risks.recommendation: Implement field-level masking to show only last 4 digits of Aadhaar numbers. Configure role-based access to limit full Aadhaar visibility to authorized personnel only.

risks.risk_name: Unmasked PAN Display to All Staff
risks.description: Full PAN numbers of both primary applicants and co-applicants are displayed without masking to all Customer Care staff, increasing risk of identity theft and unauthorized access to sensitive financial identifiers.
risks.evidence: PAN Number [UNMASKED — full PAN visible] ... Co-Applicant PAN [UNMASKED]
risks.recommendation: Implement PAN masking to show only last 4 characters. Restrict full PAN visibility to roles that require it for legitimate business purposes.

risks.risk_name: PAN Card Images Transmitted via WhatsApp
risks.description: Customers are sending PAN card images over WhatsApp Business for ID verification. These images are stored on unmanaged devices with no encryption beyond WhatsApp's E2E encryption, creating significant data breach risk.
risks.evidence: PAN card images (when asked for ID verification over chat) ... CRITICAL: Customers are sending PAN card images over WhatsApp. These images are stored on the phone with no encryption beyond WhatsApp's E2E encryption ... Phones are not MDM-managed
risks.recommendation: Implement secure document upload portal for ID verification. Prohibit PAN card transmission via WhatsApp. Deploy MDM on all business devices handling customer data.

risks.description: All Salesforce user profiles have identical read access to sensitive customer data including PAN, Aadhaar, and financial information. No field-level security is configured despite multiple requests to admin team.
risks.evidence: All three profiles have IDENTICAL read access to customer records. There is no field-level security configured. The 'CC Agent' profile sees every field including PAN, Aadhaar, financial data.
risks.recommendation: Implement role-based field-level security in Salesforce. Restrict sensitive data access based on job function and business need. Regular access reviews should be conducted.

risks.description: Team Lead and Manager profiles can export entire customer database including PAN, Aadhaar, and financial data to CSV files with no Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls in place.
risks.evidence: They can run a report on all customers and export to CSV ... No DLP controls. A team lead could export the entire customer database — including PAN, Aadhaar, financial data — to a CSV file on their local machine.
risks.recommendation: Implement DLP controls on data exports. Restrict export capabilities to specific roles with business justification. Enable audit logging for all data export activities.

risks.description: Call recordings containing customer financial and personal data are stored indefinitely with no retention policy. Recordings dating back nearly 2 years are accessible with no auto-deletion configured.
risks.evidence: Oldest recording accessible: March 2024 (nearly 2 years) ... 'I don't think anyone has set one. Ameyo just keeps everything.' Checked Ameyo admin settings — no auto-deletion configured.
risks.recommendation: Establish and implement call recording retention policy aligned with regulatory requirements. Configure automatic deletion of recordings beyond retention period.

risks.risk_name: Potential Cross-Border Data Transfer via Ameyo
risks.description: Call recordings containing customer financial and personal data may be stored outside India through Ameyo's cloud infrastructure, but hosting location is unverified despite vendor claims of India hosting.
risks.evidence: Farhan was unsure if Ameyo's cloud is in India or outside. 'Their sales team said India, but I've never verified.' ... If Ameyo stores recordings outside India, this is a cross-border transfer of customer call recordings containing financial and personal data.
risks.recommendation: Verify Ameyo's actual data hosting location through vendor documentation. If data is stored outside India, ensure proper cross-border transfer agreements and regulatory compliance.

risks.description: WhatsApp Business is used for customer financial inquiries, and Meta processes data globally, constituting cross-border transfer of customer data without proper safeguards.
risks.evidence: WhatsApp — Meta's servers. Data likely processed outside India ... At minimum, WhatsApp is almost certainly a cross-border transfer. The company is using WhatsApp Business to handle customer financial inquiries, and Meta processes data globally.
risks.recommendation: Assess regulatory compliance for WhatsApp data transfers. Consider alternative secure communication channels for customer interactions. Implement data localization controls where required.

risks.risk_name: Sensitive Personal Information in Case Descriptions
risks.description: Free-text case descriptions contain highly sensitive personal information including health situations, corruption allegations with named employees, and family relationship changes, accessible to all Customer Care staff.
risks.evidence: 'Customer says he is facing financial difficulty due to wife's hospitalization. Requested EMI moratorium.' ... 'Customer alleges that LO Mr. [Name] asked for Rs 5000 as processing fee which was not in agreement. Customer has WhatsApp messages as proof.' ... These descriptions contain sensitive personal information (health situations, corruption allegations with named employees, family relationship changes). All accessible to the full Customer Care team.
risks.recommendation: Implement guidelines for case description content. Restrict access to sensitive case information based on role. Consider structured fields instead of free-text for sensitive information.

risks.description: Call recordings are accessible to any Salesforce user with case access through embedded recording links, bypassing Ameyo's access controls and extending access beyond intended users.
risks.evidence: The recording link in Salesforce opens the recording in Ameyo's web player ... Any Salesforce user with case access can click the link and listen to the recording ... The recording link embedded in the case record bypasses Ameyo's access controls.
risks.recommendation: Review and restrict call recording access to authorized personnel only. Implement proper access controls that don't bypass vendor security measures.

risks.risk_name: Customer PII in Personal Cloud Storage
risks.description: Approximately 8,000-10,000 customer records with PII are stored in personal OneDrive accounts through compliance calling data sheets, creating unauthorized data repositories outside corporate control.
risks.evidence: Compliance_Calling data structure on Deepa's OneDrive ... Each daily sheet contains 15-30 rows (one per call). Each monthly consolidated sheet: 300-500 rows. Total estimated rows across all files: ~8,000-10,000 customer records with PII.
risks.recommendation: Migrate compliance data to corporate-controlled systems. Implement data governance policies prohibiting customer data storage in personal cloud accounts. Conduct data inventory and cleanup of existing personal repositories.

risks.risk_name: Quality Audit Data in Personal Storage
risks.description: Quality scorecard data containing customer names and account numbers (200-250 records monthly) is stored in personal OneDrive and shared via email, creating additional data exposure points.
risks.evidence: Excel files on Smita's OneDrive, organized by month ... Shared with Nikhil monthly via email ... ~200-250 audited calls per month, each with customer name and account number. Over time, this accumulates into a substantial dataset of customer identifiers linked to call quality assessments.
risks.recommendation: Implement secure corporate storage for quality audit data. Establish secure sharing mechanisms instead of email. Minimize customer identifiers in quality tracking where possible.

risks.description: Team leads and managers can export entire customer database including PAN, Aadhaar, and financial data to CSV files with no data loss prevention controls.
risks.evidence: They can run a report on all customers and export to CSV ... No DLP controls. A team lead could export the entire customer database — including PAN, Aadhaar, financial data — to a CSV file on their local machine.
risks.recommendation: Implement data loss prevention controls on Salesforce exports. Restrict bulk export capabilities and add audit logging for all data exports.

risks.description: Call recordings containing customer financial and personal data are stored indefinitely with no retention policy. Recordings dating back nearly 2 years are accessible.
risks.evidence: Asked about retention policy: Farhan said 'I don't think anyone has set one. Ameyo just keeps everything.' ... Oldest recording accessible: March 2024 (nearly 2 years)
risks.recommendation: Establish and implement a call recording retention policy. Configure automatic deletion of recordings after the required retention period.

risks.description: WhatsApp Business phones containing customer PAN images and financial communications are not under mobile device management, creating security and data governance risks.
risks.evidence: Phones are not MDM-managed (confirmed with Farhan, who checked with IT over chat during our session)
risks.recommendation: Implement mobile device management for all devices handling customer data. Establish secure backup and data protection policies for business communication devices.

risks.risk_name: Customer PII in Quality Audit Files
risks.description: Quality audit scorecards stored in OneDrive contain customer names and account numbers, accumulating substantial customer datasets over time without proper data governance.
risks.evidence: Columns: Agent Name, Agent ID, Call Date, Recording ID, Customer Name, Account Number ... ~200-250 audited calls per month, each with customer name and account number. Over time, this accumulates into a substantial dataset of customer identifiers linked to call quality assessments.
risks.recommendation: Remove customer identifiers from quality audit files or implement proper data governance controls. Use anonymized identifiers for quality tracking purposes.

risks.risk_name: Extensive Customer PII in Personal OneDrive
risks.description: Approximately 8,000-10,000 customer records with PII are stored in personal OneDrive accounts for compliance calling activities, creating unauthorized data repositories.
risks.evidence: Each daily sheet contains 15-30 rows (one per call). Each monthly consolidated sheet: 300-500 rows. Total estimated rows across all files: ~8,000-10,000 customer records with PII.
risks.recommendation: Migrate compliance calling data to approved corporate systems with proper access controls. Implement data governance policies for customer data storage and handling.

risks.description: Call recordings containing financial and personal data may be stored outside India through Ameyo's cloud infrastructure, with hosting location unverified.
risks.evidence: STORAGE LOCATION: Farhan was unsure if Ameyo's cloud is in India or outside. 'Their sales team said India, but I've never verified.' ... NOTE: If Ameyo stores recordings outside India, this is a cross-border transfer of customer call recordings containing financial and personal data.
risks.recommendation: Verify Ameyo hosting location with vendor documentation. If outside India, migrate to India-hosted solution or obtain transfer consents.

risks.risk_name: No Data Retention Policy for Call Recordings
risks.description: Call recordings are stored indefinitely without any retention policy or auto-deletion, with recordings accessible from March 2024 (nearly 2 years).
risks.evidence: Asked about retention policy: Farhan said 'I don't think anyone has set one. Ameyo just keeps everything.' Checked Ameyo admin settings — no auto-deletion configured. Oldest recording accessible: March 2024 (nearly 2 years)
risks.recommendation: Implement data retention policy with automatic deletion after regulatory retention period. Configure auto-deletion in Ameyo system.
